guard/30124.htm.text: Guard Zerome: Not long ago, I made the rounds of Death Pass. There, I saw flying harpies and medusas. I don t think a commoner could come back alive. guard/30124-1.htm.text: Guard Zerome: The Corridor of Death? It is a wide road between the Dragon Valley to the north and Dion's Horseshoe Mountain Range. Geographically, it is the only path that connects Oren and Aden. However, dangerous monsters roam its length so it is dangerous to travel without a large company.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30124-01.htm.text: Zerome: What is it? A suspicious person? Well, I didn't see any around here. Ask Vesa, right there next to you. Hey, Vesa! There's a question here for you.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30124-02.htm.text: Zerome: What is it? A suspicious person? Well, I haven't see any. Oh, wait! The person that you're describing went into town not long ago. I don't know what's going on, but it hasn't been long -- you might still be able to find him in the town.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30124-03.htm.text: Zerome: Hey, we meet again. Did you find the person you were looking for? Well, good luck!
